title: Dynamic Island
say: This is Dynamic Island: a small capsule that lives on the edge of your screen. It shows what's happening, like music, messages, mail and your AI assistant, and lets you act on it without leaving what you're doing. It runs on Linux, macOS and Windows. Let's take a tour.

title: The capsule
sub: Drag it anywhere along the edges, or to the top center
say: The capsule sits on the right edge of the screen. You can drag it up and down, over to the left edge, or up to the top center, where it becomes a pill, like the Dynamic Island on a phone. Everywhere else, your desktop stays fully clickable.

title: Now Playing
sub: Spotify, YouTube in your browser, and other players
say: When music plays, the capsule shows the album art and a moving waveform. Hover over it to see the song. You can pause, skip, shuffle, repeat, or click the progress bar to jump ahead.

title: WhatsApp
sub: Read and reply without opening WhatsApp
say: When a WhatsApp message arrives, it pops up as a card. Click Reply, type your answer, and press Enter. It's sent straight away, and you never left your work.

title: Mail
sub: Any IMAP account: Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and more
say: New mail shows up the same way. Read it on the island and reply in a few words. The reply is threaded, and a copy is saved in your Sent folder.

title: The panel
sub: Click the capsule or press Ctrl+I
say: Click the capsule, or press Control I, to open the panel. The icons beside it switch between sections. Here is the Control Center, for volume, brightness, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

title: Chats, Mail and Notes
sub: Your inbox and notes, one click away
say: Chats lists your WhatsApp conversations, with photos, videos and voice notes. Mail shows your inbox. And Notes keeps quick notes that save as you type.

title: Your assistant
sub: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter or Ollama
say: The island has its own assistant, with a character that shows what it's doing. Ask it to remember something, and it saves a note for you. Ask it to message someone, and it shows you exactly what it will send, and waits for you to allow it.

title: Settings
say: In Settings, pick a character and give it a name, choose which AI it uses, and turn packages on or off. A package adds a tab and new skills for the assistant, like chats, mail, music, documents or the CRM.

title: Documents
say: Documents works with your files. Drop them on the island or add them here. Merge PDFs, pick pages, or convert files in one tap. Or ask the assistant: here it fixes the spelling in a contract, as tracked changes you can review in Word.

title: CRM
say: The CRM keeps track of the people you work with. Import your contacts, then just tell the assistant what happened. It logs the call, and adds a follow-up for tomorrow. Anything it changes can be undone with one click.

title: Spotify
say: Connect your Spotify account to browse your playlists and albums, search for anything, and play it on any of your devices.

title: Claude Code
sub: Approvals and plan limits on the island
say: If you use Claude Code, the island shows its permission requests, so you can allow or deny them from anywhere. The rings on the Claude icon show how much of your plan you've used. And you can talk to Claude Code, by typing or by voice.

title: Get it
sub: Pick your system in the README and run the commands
say: To install it, open the README, pick your system, and run the commands in order. Use the main branch on Linux, mac on a Mac, and windows on Windows. That's Dynamic Island. Thanks for watching.
